experiment.title: SCE 1.8 Reactive Probe: Validate Automated Remediation of IMDS Downgrade Attack (v2)
experiment.description: Security Chaos Engineering experiment validating that reactive controls automatically respond to attack steps 1.2 (ec2:DescribeInstances for IMDS enumeration - T1580) and 1.7 (ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions to downgrade IMDSv2 to IMDSv1 and increase hop limit - T1562.001). Provisions a banking-tier EC2 instance with IMDSv2, CloudTrail, EventBridge rule, Lambda remediation function, and SNS-to-SQS pipeline. Both attacks succeed via attacker role; the experiment verifies within a 30-minute SLA that Lambda: (1) re-enforces IMDSv2 with hop-limit=1, (2) attaches deny-all policy to attacker role, (3) publishes remediation confirmation. v2 fixes: robust retry/backoff on transient network errors, pre-flight Lambda and EventBridge validation, extended stabilisation window, diagnostic Lambda log and EventBridge metric inspection during polling.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Reactive Lambda automatically remediates IMDS downgrade and revokes attacker permissions within SLA

probes.name: Verify IMDS restored to required and hop-limit 1, attacker role denied, and remediation notification received on SQS

method.name: Provision EC2 instance with IMDSv2, CloudTrail, EventBridge rule, Lambda remediation function, SNS-SQS pipeline, and attacker IAM role via CloudFormation
Execute attack steps 1.2 (DescribeInstances IMDS enumeration) and 1.7 (ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions IMDS downgrade to IMDSv1 with hop-limit 2) using attacker role

rollbacks.name: Remove reactive inline policy from attacker role, revert IMDS, empty S3 buckets, terminate instance, and delete CloudFormation stack with all experiment resources
